## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d6c74789acba697b441f0beea4403d2a60a017c3`
Local-runs: none

PR #12591 (card #12588). Net diff against the merge base `3eb3ec138a`: two files, one line each, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` and `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`, matching the PR's file list. Current `main` (`ae923ece22`) touches nothing under `skills/` since the merge base, so the net diff is the branch's two commits and nothing else. Both paths are governed, so the face is the governed-path one.

### ① Derived judgments

**The data-integration.md line: right.**
- `packages/types/src/data.ts` declares `export interface DataSource`. It is the sole declaration under `packages/types/src` outside tests, it extends nothing, and `packages/types/src/index.ts` re-exports `DataSource` from `./data.js`, so it is the published one. "`data.ts` lists every published `DataSource` member" is TRUE.
- Measured at the head: 36 distinct members, 6 required (`find`, `findOne`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `getObjectSchema`) and 30 optional, no overloads. The PR body's **36** is right; the removed **38** was false.
- Teaching meaning kept: the caveat still says the fence is a simplified copy, and the same paragraph still points at `packages/types/src/data.ts`. No number stands in for the old one.

**The testing.md line: the pointer half right, the reach half wrong.**
- `packages/auth/src/types.ts` declares `export interface AuthClient`, the sole declaration under `packages/`, extending nothing; `packages/auth/src/index.ts` re-exports `AuthClient` and `AuthProvider`. The pointer half of the line is TRUE. Measured: 39 members, all function-typed property signatures, none optional. The PR body's **39** is right; the removed **~38** was false. No number stands in for it.
- ⛔ "the provider reaches ONE on this path" is FALSE at the head. Read in `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx`: the mount effect calls `loadSession`, which reaches `client.getSession()` (one). When that resolves with a user, the effect commented "Load organizations once user is authenticated" (deps `user`, `enabled`, `isPreviewMode`; the fence passes neither `enabled={false}` nor `previewMode`) calls `refreshOrganizations`, which reaches `client.listOrganizations()` (two). On the fence's one-member stub that call is a TypeError thrown inside `refreshOrganizations`' `try`, caught, and reported as `console.warn('[AuthProvider] Failed to load organizations:', …)`. `isLoading` was already lowered in `loadSession`'s `finally`, so "Hello Alice" renders and the example passes, with a warning, not because only one member is reached. `refreshActiveMember` returns before `client.getActiveMember()` (no active organization), so the count on this path is exactly TWO: `getSession` and `listOrganizations`.
- The claim is pre-existing (the removed line said the same), but the PR rewrote the line and re-asserts the claim as checked: dev report round 2 ("Its teaching claim, that the provider reaches ONE member, is kept") and the PR body ("the stub needs only the one member the provider reaches"). Kept, yes; true, no. The card's whole class is a published skill sentence the code does not bear out, and this rewritten line still carries one, so it does not tell agents the truth.
- Remedy, one line in place (keeps 370): say what is true. The session load reaches `getSession` only; the organization load that follows authentication reaches `listOrganizations` and absorbs its absence with a `console.warn`. Or stub `listOrganizations` too and say TWO. Correct the PR body sentence quoted above with it. For the seat, outside this diff: the unchanged next line "This is the shape `@object-ui/auth`'s own AuthProvider.test.tsx uses" is loose too. `createMockClient` there stubs eight members and its own comment still says "~38 methods", the same family.

**Spot-checks of the Acceptance-notes counts**, each against its declaration at the head:
- "Six members are **required**": `DataSource` has 6 required. Right.
- "the nine keys" and "those nine keys": `QueryParams` in `data.ts` has 9 keys. Right.
- "seven members": `QueryResult` has 7 (`data` required plus 6 optional). Right.
- "Sixteen keys in total": `ComponentMeta` in `base.ts` has 11 and `RegistryComponentMetaExtras` in `Registry.ts` has 5. Right.
- "The eleven control kinds": `ComponentInputControlType` has 11 arms. Right.
- "SIX keys are writable": `ComponentInput` has 14 members, 8 typed `never`. Right.
- The six breakpoint keys: `BreakpointName` has 6 arms and `BreakpointColumnMap` has 6 members. Right.
- "default 1000 entries": `ExpressionCache`'s constructor default is `maxSize = 1000`. Right.
- Not re-derived here: the two spec-side ones (`GanttConfigSchema`, `EXPRESSION_BINDABLE_TEXT_KEYS_BY_COMPONENT`) and "The seven props a widget author writes" (the fence's own `Pick`).
- No `38` or `~38` remains anywhere under `skills/objectui/`. Line budget as stated: 514, 370, 142.

**Gates.** Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-16T01:39Z: 30 success (Lint, Type Check, Repo Gates, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, the three Changeset gates, Build Docs, Build & E2E, Test (dist pins), all 16 Test shards and the Test aggregate, label), 3 skipped (dependabot and the coverage pair), and 1 still in progress, Spec Main Shape Gate. No failure. The earlier head `b55c042e59`'s "Test" failure: its annotations say 15 shards did not report success, every one `cancelled` (shard 1 passed), and the aggregate exits 3 because it refuses cancelled shards by design (objectui#9499). The push of `d6c74789ac` superseded that run. A cancellation artefact, not a test result.

### ② Semver level

No changeset owed: `skills/` ships in no npm package and no package source changed. `Clause-②: no` is on the claim and on PR body line 2. Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read and Changeset Fixed Group Check all pass on the head. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- R1 note, line 33 vs 34: the hunk `@@ -31,7 +31,7` has three context lines before the change, so the number sat on line 34 and the sentence began on 33. Both citations were right about different things. Immaterial.
- R1 note, provenance of `6479086867` NOT MEASURED (shallow boundary): the fix does not depend on it. No action.
- R1 deviation, line addresses in the report comment rather than the PR body (AGENTS.md #11): accepted. The PR body carries none (checked), and the report pins each to `3eb3ec138a` beside the quoted text.
- R1 deviation, gates re-run in the resumed run: accepted.
- R1 out-of-scope finding (`AuthClient` ~38): folded in by the seat in round 2. It is the line that fails above.
- R2 deviation, the dev declined the PR-body PATCH and the seat sent it: confirmed. The PR timeline shows the retitle to "docs(skills): point two published member counts at their declarations instead of numbers (objectui#12588)" by the fleet bot after the round-2 report. The body is 8082 bytes, names both sentences in "What changed" and in 维护者速读, carries the testing.md row in the line-budget table, cites the head `d6c74789ac`, and keeps `Fixes #12588` on line 1 and `Clause-②: no` on line 2. It matches the diff, except for its reach sentence, flagged in ①.
- R2 note, `origin/main` moved to `ae923ece22` with nothing under `skills/`: verified.
- `open_questions`: none in either round. Nothing is escalated beyond ①.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7b2bb22f71574c15a8afc54e76fe300cff6deb07`
Local-runs: none

PR #12591 (card #12588), round 3: does this head discharge the FAIL record `6206067543` at `d6c74789ac` and the rework ruling `6206085267`? Net diff against the merge base `3eb3ec138a`: two files, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` (+1/−1) and `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` (+6/−6), matching the PR's file list; the branch's three commits and nothing else. `origin/main` (`92c2a69769`) touches nothing under `skills/`, `packages/auth/`, `packages/types/src/data.ts` or `packages/types/src/index.ts` since the merge base, so the code each sentence is judged against is the same at the head and on `main`. Both paths are governed, so the face is the governed-path one.

### ① Derived judgments

**data-integration.md (unchanged since `d6c74789ac`): right.**
- `packages/types/src/data.ts` declares `export interface DataSource`, extending nothing. `packages/types/src/index.ts` re-exports `DataSource` from `./data.js`. No other `interface DataSource` exists under `packages/` at the head (the other three hits in the tree are a docs page, an example app's private mock and the guide's own teaching fence), and no package source carries a `declare module '@object-ui/types'` augmentation. So "`data.ts` lists every published `DataSource` member" is TRUE.
- Measured at the head: 36 members, 6 required (`find`, `findOne`, `create`, `update`, `delete`, `getObjectSchema`) and 30 optional, no overloads. The PR body's 36 = 6 + 30 is right; the removed 38 was false. The section's later "Six members are **required**" holds.
- No count stands in for the old one; the sentence takes the shape the same section's optional-member sentence already has ("`data.ts` lists every optional member"), as the card asked. No `38` or `~38` remains anywhere under `skills/`.

**testing.md, the "Auth provider testing" fence: right, and it discharges the FAIL.**
- The pointer: `packages/auth/src/types.ts` declares `export interface AuthClient`, the sole declaration, extending nothing; `packages/auth/src/index.ts` re-exports it. 39 members, all function-typed. No count stands in for the removed "~38" or for the removed "ONE".
- The reach, walked in `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx` at the head for a mount with the fence's props (`client` given, `enabled` defaulting to true, no `previewMode`), effect by effect in hook order:
  - `client` is memoised to the external stub, so `createAuthClient` is never called.
  - The rotation effect calls `TokenStorage.subscribeRotation` (not an `AuthClient` member) and re-runs `loadSession` only on a token rotation, which this path never produces.
  - The mount effect calls `loadSession`, which reaches `client.getSession()` — the one call on mount.
  - `onAuthStateChange` is not passed; `authGateEvents.subscribe` and `SessionUserScope.adopt` touch no client member.
  - The `refreshActiveMember` effect runs on mount and returns at `!activeOrganization` BEFORE `client.getActiveMember()`; its deps (`client`, `enabled`, `isPreviewMode`, `previewMode`, `activeOrganization`) never change on this path because `activeOrganization` stays null, so it never re-runs into that call.
  - The "Load organizations once user is authenticated" effect (deps `user`, `enabled`, `isPreviewMode`) runs once `getSession` has set `user` and calls `refreshOrganizations`, which reaches `client.listOrganizations()`. With `[]`: `setOrganizations([])`, then the `orgs.length` guard is false for an empty list, so `getActiveOrganization` and `setActiveOrganization` are not reached and the function returns; `finally` resolves the two flags. No throw, no `console.warn`. `user` is set once (no other `loadSession` caller fires on this path), so this runs once.
  - `useAuth` reads context only; `AuthConsumer` renders state.
  So "this path reaches `getSession` on mount and `listOrganizations` once a user is set; an empty list ends the organization load there" is TRUE: exactly two members are reached, and no other `AuthClient` member is reached that the two-member stub would leave to warn or throw. Should the test's `waitFor` resolve before `listOrganizations` settles, the effect cleanup's `cancelled` flag suppresses the warn branch anyway.
- The stub line: `AuthClient['listOrganizations']` is declared as a zero-argument function returning a `Promise` of `AuthOrganization[]`. The repo pins vitest 4.1.10, whose `vi.fn` takes the function type as its one type argument, the way the existing `getSession` stub already uses it; `mockResolvedValue` then takes the awaited return, `AuthOrganization[]`, and `[]` is assignable to it. The key is checked by the `Partial`-of-`AuthClient` literal, and the widening stays the single `as unknown as AuthClient`. Right. The dev's scratch `tsc` and vitest runs are consistent with this reading; they are reported, not re-run here.
- The rest of the rewritten comment keeps the teaching claim, and it is true: the `Partial` literal checks the key, the typed `vi.fn` checks the signature, `mockResolvedValue` checks the resolved value. "ONCE" and "all three" name the single cast and the three checks the sentence itself enumerates — not member counts, so they cannot drift with the declaration.
- Dropping "This is the shape `@object-ui/auth`'s own AuthProvider.test.tsx uses": right. In `packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx`, `createMockClient` types only its `overrides` parameter as `Partial` of `AuthClient`; every stub is an untyped `vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(...)` and the literal is cast `as unknown as AuthClient`, so the discipline the fence teaches (each stub typed against its own member, resolved value checked) is not that file's shape. The sentence was untrue, and ruling 3 allowed the drop. The PR body's second reason — a reader of the published guide cannot open that file — is weak (the same comment now names `packages/auth/src/types.ts`, a repo path, as the guides do throughout), but the first reason carries the drop on its own.
- Against record `6206067543`: its one FAIL item was "the provider reaches ONE on this path". The head names the two members, stubs both, and closes the warn path. Discharged. Against ruling `6206085267`: 1 (members named, no count) met; 2 (both stubbed, each typed against `AuthClient[...]`, `[]`, measured with no warn and the old stub shown warning) met per the round-3 report; 3 (shape line measured and dropped; `packages/auth` untouched; the test-file comment carried as an acceptance note) met; 4 (`data-integration.md` 514 and 514, `testing.md` 370 and 370, `SKILL.md` 142 and 142, read with `wc -l` over `git show`) met; 5 (body v3 on the PR) met, see ③.

**PR body measured claims, spot-checked:** 36 = 6 + 30, right; 39, right; "`refreshActiveMember` makes no client call while no organization is active", right; "an empty list returns from `refreshOrganizations` before `getActiveOrganization` or `setActiveOrganization`", right; numstat +1/−1 and +6/−6, right (six comment lines out; five comment lines and one stub line in); the line-budget table, right; "the fence carries no example-gate marker, so `check-skill-examples` does not judge it", right — that gate is opt-in by an HTML marker on the line directly above a fence, and the Pattern 6 fence has none (the opt-out note belongs to Pattern 7, a different fence); body line 1 `Fixes #12588` and line 2 `Clause-②: no`, right; "no angle-bracket shapes", right (none in the body as read back).

**Acceptance-notes counts, spot-checked at the head:** "the nine keys" — `QueryParams` has 9 `$`-keys, right; "seven members" — `QueryResult` has `data` plus 6 optional, right; "SIX keys are writable" — `ComponentInput` has 14 members, 8 typed `never`, right; "The eleven control kinds" — `ComponentInputControlType` has 11 arms, right; "Sixteen keys in total" — `ComponentMeta` 11 plus `RegistryComponentMetaExtras` 5, right; the six breakpoints — `BreakpointName` has 6 arms, right; "default 1000 entries" — `ExpressionCache`'s `constructor(maxSize = 1000)`, right. The `AuthProvider.test.tsx` note: the `createMockClient` comment says "~38" and "eight"; the literal names 7 members plus the `overrides` spread, and the file never mentions `listOrganizations`, right. Not re-derived here: the two spec-side counts (`GanttConfigSchema`, `EXPRESSION_BINDABLE_TEXT_KEYS_BY_COMPONENT`) and the seven-prop `Pick`, which the earlier record also left; the diff touches none of them.

**Gates.** Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-16T02:03Z: 29 success — Repo Gates, Lint, Type Check, Build Docs, Build & E2E, Test (dist pins), all 16 Test shards and the Test aggregate, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Fixed Group Check, label; 3 skipped (dependabot and the coverage pair); 1 still in progress at that reading, Spec Main Shape Gate, which the diff (prose under `skills/` only) gives nothing to judge. No failure.

### ② Semver level

No changeset is owed: `skills/` ships in no npm package and nothing under `packages/` changed. `Clause-②: no` stands on the claim and on PR body line 2. Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read and Changeset Fixed Group Check are green on the head. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- R1 note, line 33 vs 34: the hunk's three context lines put the sentence on 33 and the number on 34; both citations right, immaterial.
- R1 note, provenance of `6479086867` NOT MEASURED (shallow boundary): the fix does not depend on it. No action.
- R1 deviation, line addresses in the report comment rather than the PR body: accepted; the body carries none.
- R1 deviation, gates re-run in the resumed run: accepted.
- R1 out-of-scope finding (`~38`): folded in by the seat in R2; it is the fence this round repairs.
- R2 deviation, the dev declined the PR-body PATCH and the seat sent v2: confirmed by the fleet bot's rename event on the PR timeline after the R2 report.
- R2 note, `origin/main` moved with nothing under `skills/`: still true at `92c2a69769`, and nothing under `packages/auth/` either.
- R3 acceptance note (`AuthProvider.test.tsx`'s "~38 / eight" comment, and no `listOrganizations` in its double): measured true above. Ruling 3 forbade the edit, so that file's authenticated-session tests still run through the `console.warn` path the fence used to. Escalated to the seat as a candidate follow-up in this card's shape; no action in this PR.
- R3 deviations: none. `open_questions`: none in any round.
- PR body v3 is the body on the PR: 11302 bytes, cites the head `7b2bb22f71` in the line-budget table and the verification heading, carries the scratch-measurement section, states the two-member reach in "What changed", "Why" and 维护者速读, keeps `Fixes #12588` on line 1 and `Clause-②: no` on line 2, and the PR's last update postdates the round-3 report. The title (renamed by the fleet bot in R2) names both files' scope. Body and title match the diff.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**：给使用者 agent 读的已发布技能指南里，有两处关于接口的说法与代码不符，本 PR 把它们改成代码实际的样子，不再写死任何数字。两个文件的行数都不变：514 行和 370 行。
- `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`：原文「`DataSource` 有 38 个成员」，改为「完整的成员清单在 `data.ts`」。只改一行。
- `skills/objectui/guides/testing.md` 的认证测试示例：
  - 原注释说「`AuthClient` 约有 38 个方法，provider 在这条路径上只用到一个」。实际用到两个：挂载时调用 `getSession`，用户登录后再调用 `listOrganizations`。注释现在直接点名这两个方法，不写数字。
  - 示例里的测试替身补上 `listOrganizations`，返回空列表。
  - 删掉「这和 `@object-ui/auth` 自己的测试写法一致」一句。实测不一致：那个文件的替身没有按成员加类型。

**为什么改**：
- 两个数字都是错的：实测 `DataSource` 有 36 个成员，`AuthClient` 有 39 个方法。接口每增删一个成员，写死的数字就会再错一次。
- 「只用到一个」也是错的。照旧示例写的测试虽然能通过，但会打出一条「组织加载失败」的警告，读者照抄就会把这个隐患带进自己的项目。
- 新示例实测通过，没有任何警告。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：
- 只改文档和示例代码，不改任何包，不发 npm 包，不需要 changeset。
- 风险极低：读者少了两个本来就错的数字，换来可以自己核对的位置；示例多了一行替身。
- 回滚：revert 本 PR 即可。

**席位意见**：建议批准。
- 第一轮只改 data-integration.md 一句。第二轮按本席决定，把 testing.md 的同类计数一并纳入。
- 本席发起的高档复审第一次判 FAIL（`6206067543`），指出「只用到一个」不属实。本席据此裁定返工（`6206085267`）：点名方法、补齐替身。
- 第二次高档复审 PASS（`6206377097`），CI 全绿。

**你要做的**：用 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准本 PR。批准后由本席翻 ready、加入合并队列。
